typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblY14TradeTestingLogicStage2_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		High as integer,
		Low as integer,
		SOR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblY14TradeTestingStage1
fromtblY14TradeTestingStage1 sink(input(
		High as integer,
		Low as integer,
		SOR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		High,
		Low,
		SOR),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblY14TradeTestingLogicStage2_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblY14TradeTestingLogicStage2
